<thought>We have the mass spectrum showing a base peak at m/z 121.05 with an M+1 intensity of ~8 %, indicating roughly eight carbons (each 13C contributes ~1 %). This points to a molecular formula of C₈H₉O (exact monoisotopic mass 121.0653 Da), which is consistent with the observed mass within typical instrument tolerance. To identify the exact structure, we need the ¹H NMR spectrum to see the number and type of proton environments. This will let us propose a specific SMILES string.</thought>
